column1: *** Alejandro LERENA LENGUAS ***
column2: *** 29 May 1845 *** - "que nacio el veinte y nueve de Mayo del pasado ano"
column4: Baptised 7 January 1846 at La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, with his brother Luis Eugenio and his sister Justiniana Mauricia Maxima
column5: *** KNOWN AND PRIMARY: Luis Lerena and Justiniana Lenguas. *** He is a brother of Luis Eugenio and of Gilberto.

column3: Julia BASSANI (indexed also Basani, Bossani, Barsani, Balani)
column4: A large Buenos Aires family: Hector Narciso, Emilia Alberta, Romeo Rosario, Julieta Eugenia, Carmen Romualda, Maria Luisa, Elisa Cornelia, Julia Cecilia Eugenia. Argentine military records 1911-1936; Capital Federal parish records; a son born at Montevideo in 1886
column5: *** NOT KNOWN. *** No record found on 14 September names his parents. This is the whole obstacle.

column1: # *** THE VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE, AND DELIBERATELY SO. ***
# The two candidates differ by six years - 1845 against 1839 - which is well inside the range this
# archive has repeatedly seen between a baptism act and a stated age. Against that, nothing positive
# links them.
# One echo, offered as nothing more: Alejandro MAXIMO shares a name with his supposed sister
# JUSTINIANA MAURICIA MAXIMA, whose own act was read the same week. Family names repeat, and that is
# a reason to look rather than a reason to believe.
# *** WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: any record naming Alejandro Maximo Lerena's PARENTS. *** The likeliest
# are his marriage to Julia Bassani, or the baptism of his eldest child - Capital Federal parish
# records name grandparents as a matter of course, as the Retiro informacion matrimonial did for his
# nephew Carlos. Neither has been located yet.
